questions.q: What is the role of decomposers such as bacteria and fungi in an ecosystem?
questions.qAf: Wat is die rol van ontbinders soos bakterieë en swamme in 'n ekosisteem?
options: They break down dead matter and return nutrients to the soil
They turn oxygen into carbon dioxide only
optionsAf: Hulle breek dooie materiaal af en gee voedingstowwe aan die grond terug
Hulle verander net suurstof in koolstofdioksied
questions.explain: Without decomposers, nutrients would stay locked in dead material. They recycle nutrients so producers can use them again.
questions.explainAf: Sonder ontbinders sou voedingstowwe in dooie materiaal vasgevang bly. Hulle herwin voedingstowwe sodat produsente dit weer kan gebruik.

questions.q: One bacterium divides by binary fission every 20 minutes. How many bacteria will there be after 1 hour?
questions.qAf: Een bakterie verdeel elke 20 minute deur binêre splitsing. Hoeveel bakterieë sal daar na 1 uur wees?
questions.explain: 1 hour is three divisions: 1 → 2 → 4 → 8. The number doubles every 20 minutes.
questions.explainAf: 1 uur is drie verdelings: 1 → 2 → 4 → 8. Die getal verdubbel elke 20 minute.

questions.q: What did Louis Pasteur show?
questions.qAf: Wat het Louis Pasteur bewys?
options: That the first vaccine works against smallpox
optionsAf: Dat die eerste entstof teen pokke werk
questions.explain: Pasteur proved germ theory and developed pasteurisation: heating food to kill harmful bacteria. Edward Jenner made the smallpox vaccine.
questions.explainAf: Pasteur het die kiemteorie bewys en pasteurisasie ontwikkel: om voedsel te verhit om skadelike bakterieë dood te maak. Edward Jenner het die pokke-entstof gemaak.

questions.q: A plant is kept at 45 °C. Why does its rate of photosynthesis drop sharply?
questions.qAf: 'n Plant word by 45 °C gehou. Waarom daal sy fotosintesetempo skerp?
options: The enzymes that control photosynthesis are destroyed (denatured)
The plant has run out of chlorophyll
optionsAf: Die ensieme wat fotosintese beheer, word vernietig (gedenatureer)
Die plant se chlorofil is op
questions.explain: Photosynthesis is controlled by enzymes. The rate rises up to about 25 °C, and above about 40 °C the enzymes denature.
questions.explainAf: Fotosintese word deur ensieme beheer. Die tempo styg tot ongeveer 25 °C, en bo ongeveer 40 °C denatureer die ensieme.

questions.q: Water is always H₂O, never H₃O or HO. Which idea does this show?
questions.qAf: Water is altyd H₂O, nooit H₃O of HO nie. Watter idee wys dit?
options: A compound has its elements in a fixed ratio
A mixture can have any ratio
optionsAf: 'n Verbinding het sy elemente in 'n vaste verhouding
questions.explain: The elements in a compound are always in a fixed, definite ratio: the Law of Definite Proportions. A mixture's composition can vary.
questions.explainAf: Die elemente in 'n verbinding is altyd in 'n vaste, bepaalde verhouding: die Wet van Konstante Samestelling. 'n Mengsel se samestelling kan wissel.

questions.q: Sodium is a dangerously reactive metal and chlorine is a toxic gas, yet sodium chloride is ordinary table salt. Why?
questions.qAf: Natrium is 'n gevaarlik reaktiewe metaal en chloor is 'n giftige gas, tog is natriumchloried gewone tafelsout. Waarom?
options: A compound has completely different properties from the elements it is made of
The sodium and chlorine are only mixed, not bonded
optionsAf: 'n Verbinding het heeltemal ander eienskappe as die elemente waaruit dit bestaan
Die natrium en chloor is net gemeng, nie gebind nie
questions.explain: Forming a compound is a chemical change. The new substance, NaCl, has properties of its own, unlike sodium or chlorine.
questions.explainAf: Om 'n verbinding te vorm, is 'n chemiese verandering. Die nuwe stof, NaCl, het sy eie eienskappe, anders as natrium of chloor.

questions.q: A drop of food colouring slowly spreads through a glass of still water. What is this called?
questions.qAf: 'n Druppel voedselkleursel versprei stadig deur 'n glas stil water. Wat word dit genoem?
questions.explain: Diffusion is the movement of particles from high to low concentration, because particles move randomly all the time. It is faster in gases than in liquids.
questions.explainAf: Diffusie is die beweging van deeltjies van 'n hoë na 'n lae konsentrasie, omdat deeltjies heeltyd lukraak beweeg. Dit is vinniger in gasse as in vloeistowwe.

questions.q: Chlorine is in Group 17. How many electrons does it have in its outer shell?
questions.qAf: Chloor is in Groep 17. Hoeveel elektrone het dit in sy buitenste dop?
questions.explain: For main-group elements, the group number tells you the valence electrons: Group 17 elements all have 7.
questions.explainAf: Vir hoofgroep-elemente sê die groepnommer vir jou hoeveel valenselektrone daar is: Groep 17-elemente het almal 7.

questions.q: A charged ruler is held near small pieces of tissue paper. What happens?
questions.qAf: 'n Gelaaide liniaal word naby klein stukkies snesiepapier gehou. Wat gebeur?
options: The paper is attracted, because the ruler induces an opposite charge on it
The paper is pushed away, because paper is always positive
Nothing happens, because paper is neutral
optionsAf: Die papier word aangetrek, omdat die liniaal 'n teenoorgestelde lading daarop induseer
Die papier word weggestoot, omdat papier altyd positief is
Niks gebeur nie, omdat papier neutraal is
questions.explain: The charged ruler induces an opposite charge on the near side of the paper, and opposite charges attract.
questions.explainAf: Die gelaaide liniaal induseer 'n teenoorgestelde lading aan die naaste kant van die papier, en teenoorgestelde ladings trek mekaar aan.

questions.q: Why is it safer to be inside a car than in an open field during a lightning storm?
questions.qAf: Waarom is dit veiliger om in 'n motor as in 'n oop veld te wees tydens 'n weerligstorm?
options: The metal shell conducts the charge safely around you
The rubber tyres make you invisible to lightning
Cars attract the lightning away from people
optionsAf: Die metaaldop gelei die lading veilig om jou
Die rubberbande maak jou onsigbaar vir weerlig
Weerlig slaan nooit bewegende voorwerpe nie
Motors trek die weerlig weg van mense
questions.explain: The metal shell of the car conducts the charge around the people inside. In an open field you may be the tallest object.
questions.explainAf: Die metaaldop van die motor gelei die lading om die mense binne. In 'n oop veld is jy dalk die hoogste voorwerp.

questions.q: White light passes through a triangular prism. Which colour bends the most?
questions.qAf: Wit lig gaan deur 'n driehoekige prisma. Watter kleur buig die meeste?
questions.explain: Violet bends most at both faces of the prism and red bends least, so white light fans out into the spectrum.
questions.explainAf: Violet buig die meeste by albei vlakke van die prisma en rooi die minste, dus waaier wit lig uit in die spektrum.

questions.q: A wall looks red in sunlight. What is the wall doing with the light?
questions.qAf: 'n Muur lyk rooi in sonlig. Wat doen die muur met die lig?
options: Reflecting red light and absorbing the other colours
Absorbing red light and reflecting the other colours
optionsAf: Dit weerkaats rooi lig en absorbeer die ander kleure
Dit absorbeer rooi lig en weerkaats die ander kleure
Dit maak sy eie rooi lig
questions.explain: The colour you see is the colour that is reflected to your eye. The other colours are absorbed.
questions.explainAf: Die kleur wat jy sien, is die kleur wat na jou oog weerkaats word. Die ander kleure word geabsorbeer.

questions.q: A resistor has 8 V across it and a current of 2 A through it. What is its resistance? (R = V ÷ I)
questions.qAf: 'n Resistor het 8 V daaroor en 'n stroom van 2 A daardeur. Wat is sy weerstand? (R = V ÷ I)

questions.q: What is load shedding?
questions.qAf: Wat is beurtkrag?
options: Planned power cuts when the demand for electricity is greater than the supply
Sending electricity at very high voltage
Switching homes over to solar power
optionsAf: Beplande kragonderbrekings wanneer die vraag na elektrisiteit groter as die aanbod is
Om elektrisiteit teen baie hoë spanning te stuur
Om huise na sonkrag oor te skakel
'n Fout wat deur weerlig veroorsaak word
questions.explain: Supply is cut in some areas on purpose to protect the whole grid. Using electricity carefully at home eases the pressure.
questions.explainAf: Die aanbod word doelbewus in sommige gebiede afgesny om die hele netwerk te beskerm. Om elektrisiteit tuis versigtig te gebruik, verlig die druk.

questions.q: Which of these is one reason why Earth can support life?
questions.qAf: Watter een hiervan is een rede waarom die Aarde lewe kan onderhou?
options: It is the right distance from the Sun for liquid water
optionsAf: Dit is die regte afstand van die Son vir vloeibare water
questions.explain: Earth is in the habitable zone. It also has a protective atmosphere, a magnetic field and a stable tilt that gives seasons.
questions.explainAf: Die Aarde is in die bewoonbare sone. Dit het ook 'n beskermende atmosfeer, 'n magneetveld en 'n stabiele kanteling wat seisoene gee.

questions.q: Mercury's year lasts only 88 Earth days, but Neptune's lasts 165 Earth years. Why?
questions.qAf: Mercurius se jaar duur net 88 Aarde-dae, maar Neptunus s'n duur 165 Aarde-jare. Waarom?
options: Planets closer to the Sun orbit faster and have a shorter path
Mercury spins faster on its axis
optionsAf: Planete nader aan die Son wentel vinniger en het 'n korter baan
Mercurius draai vinniger om sy as
questions.explain: The closer a planet is to the Sun, the faster it orbits and the shorter its orbital period (its year).
questions.explainAf: Hoe nader 'n planeet aan die Son is, hoe vinniger wentel dit en hoe korter is sy wentelperiode (sy jaar).

questions.q: Why are MeerKAT and the SKA built in the Karoo?
questions.qAf: Waarom word MeerKAT en die SKA in die Karoo gebou?
options: There is very little radio interference there
It is the highest place in Africa
It is close to the sea
optionsAf: Daar is baie min radio-steuring daar
Dit is die hoogste plek in Afrika
Dit word nooit donker daar nie
questions.explain: Radio telescopes need quiet skies. The Karoo's low radio-frequency interference and clear skies make it ideal.
questions.explainAf: Radioteleskope het stil lugruim nodig. Die Karoo se lae radiofrekwensie-steuring en helder lug maak dit ideaal.

questions.q: What can a radio telescope do that an ordinary optical telescope cannot?
questions.qAf: Wat kan 'n radioteleskoop doen wat 'n gewone optiese teleskoop nie kan nie?
options: Work day and night, even through clouds
optionsAf: Dag en nag werk, selfs deur wolke
questions.explain: Radio telescopes collect radio waves, which pass through clouds and can be detected in daylight.
questions.explainAf: Radioteleskope versamel radiogolwe, wat deur wolke gaan en bedags opgespoor kan word.

questions.q: How does the Southern Cross (Crux) help with navigation in the Southern Hemisphere?
questions.qAf: Hoe help die Suiderkruis (Crux) met navigasie in die Suidelike Halfrond?
options: Its long axis points towards the South Celestial Pole
It always rises exactly in the east
It is the brightest star in the sky
optionsAf: Sy lang as wys na die Suidelike Hemelpool
Dit kom altyd presies in die ooste op
Dit is die helderste ster in die lug
questions.explain: Follow the long axis of the Southern Cross to find the South Celestial Pole, and from there, south.
questions.explainAf: Volg die Suiderkruis se lang as om die Suidelike Hemelpool te vind, en van daar af die suide.

questions.q: In the tradition of many southern African peoples, what did the rising of the Pleiades (Selemela) signal?
questions.qAf: Wat het die opkoms van die Pleiades (Selemela) in die tradisie van baie Suider-Afrikaanse volke aangedui?
optionsAf: Die tyd om gewasse te plant
questions.explain: Star positions guided seasonal activities such as hunting and planting. The Pleiades signalled planting time.
questions.explainAf: Sterposisies het seisoenale aktiwiteite soos jag en plant gerig. Die Pleiades het die planttyd aangedui.

questions.q: About how long ago did the universe begin, in the Big Bang?
questions.qAf: Ongeveer hoe lank gelede het die heelal in die Oerknal ontstaan?
questions.explain: The universe began about 13.8 billion years ago. The solar system is much younger: about 4.6 billion years.
questions.explainAf: Die heelal het ongeveer 13,8 miljard jaar gelede ontstaan. Die sonnestelsel is baie jonger: ongeveer 4,6 miljard jaar.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: Bacteria are single-celled organisms with no nucleus.
questions.qAf: Bakterieë is eensellige organismes sonder 'n kern.
questions.explain: True. Bacteria are prokaryotes. Protists, by contrast, are mostly single-celled but do have a nucleus.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Bakterieë is prokariote. Protiste, daarteenoor, is meestal eensellig maar het wel 'n kern.

questions.q: When a metal rod is heated and expands, its particles get bigger.
questions.qAf: Wanneer 'n metaalstaaf verhit word en uitsit, word sy deeltjies groter.
questions.explain: False. The number and size of the particles stay the same. They move faster and the spaces between them get bigger.
questions.explainAf: Onwaar. Die aantal en grootte van die deeltjies bly dieselfde. Hulle beweeg vinniger en die ruimtes tussen hulle word groter.

questions.q: Light needs a medium such as air to travel through.
questions.qAf: Lig het 'n medium soos lug nodig om deur te beweeg.
questions.explain: False. Light can travel through a vacuum at 300 000 km/s; that is how sunlight reaches us. Sound is the one that needs a medium.
questions.explainAf: Onwaar. Lig kan teen 300 000 km/s deur 'n vakuum beweeg; dit is hoe sonlig ons bereik. Klank is die een wat 'n medium nodig het.

questions.q: All the planets orbit the Sun in the same direction because they formed from the same rotating cloud of gas.
questions.qAf: Al die planete wentel in dieselfde rigting om die Son omdat hulle uit dieselfde draaiende gaswolk gevorm het.
questions.explain: True. The solar system formed about 4.6 billion years ago from one giant rotating cloud of gas and dust.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Die sonnestelsel het ongeveer 4,6 miljard jaar gelede uit een reuse draaiende wolk van gas en stof gevorm.

questions.q: Constellations appear to move across the sky during the night because Earth rotates.
questions.qAf: Sterrebeelde lyk asof hulle gedurende die nag oor die lug beweeg omdat die Aarde draai.
questions.explain: True. They also change with the seasons, because Earth orbits the Sun.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Hulle verander ook met die seisoene, omdat die Aarde om die Son wentel.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each kind of ecosystem service to an example of it.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke soort ekosisteemdiens aan 'n voorbeeld daarvan.
pairs: Tourism in the Kruger National Park
questions.explain: Provisioning services give us things to use, regulating services keep the environment stable, and cultural services include tourism and recreation.
questions.explainAf: Voorsieningsdienste gee ons dinge om te gebruik, reguleringsdienste hou die omgewing stabiel, en kulturele dienste sluit toerisme en ontspanning in.

questions.q: Match each kind of sound in column A with its frequency range in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke soort klank in kolom A by sy frekwensiegebied in kolom B.
questions.explain: Humans hear from about 20 Hz to 20 000 Hz. Elephants communicate with infrasound, and bats and dogs can hear ultrasound.
questions.explainAf: Mense hoor van ongeveer 20 Hz tot 20 000 Hz. Olifante kommunikeer met infraklank, en vlermuise en honde kan ultraklank hoor.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each constellation to a fact about it.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke sterrebeeld aan 'n feit daaroor.
pairsAf: Maklik om in die winter te sien
questions.explain: From South Africa, Scorpius is a winter constellation and Orion a summer one. Centaurus contains the nearest star system.
questions.explainAf: Vanaf Suid-Afrika is die Skerpioen 'n wintersterrebeeld en Orion 'n somersterrebeeld. Centaurus bevat die naaste sterstelsel.

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Put these atomic models in the order in which they were proposed.
questions.qAf: Plaas hierdie atoommodelle in die volgorde waarin hulle voorgestel is.
questions.explain: Each model fixed something the one before it got wrong. Bohr's shells are the model used in Grade 8.
questions.explainAf: Elke model het iets reggestel wat die vorige een verkeerd gehad het. Bohr se doppe is die model wat in Graad 8 gebruik word.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: In a game reserve, a disease suddenly kills most of the wild dogs. Wild dogs are predators that hunt impala, and impala eat grass and leaves.
questions.scenarioAf: In 'n wildreservaat maak 'n siekte skielik die meeste wildehonde dood. Wildehonde is roofdiere wat rooibokke jag, en rooibokke eet gras en blare.

questions.q: What is most likely to happen to the impala population over the next few years?
questions.qAf: Wat sal heel waarskynlik oor die volgende paar jaar met die rooibokbevolking gebeur?
questions.explain: With fewer predators hunting them, more impala survive, so their numbers grow.
questions.explainAf: Met minder roofdiere wat hulle jag, oorleef meer rooibokke, dus groei hul getalle.

questions.q: What then happens to the grass and leaves in the reserve?
questions.qAf: Wat gebeur dan met die gras en blare in die reservaat?
options: More of them are eaten, putting pressure on the vegetation
They grow taller because there are fewer wild dogs
optionsAf: Meer daarvan word geëet, wat druk op die plantegroei plaas
Dit groei hoër omdat daar minder wildehonde is
questions.explain: More impala eat more plants. This is how a change at one level spreads through the whole food web.
questions.explainAf: Meer rooibokke eet meer plante. Dit is hoe 'n verandering op een vlak deur die hele voedselweb versprei.

questions.q: Which trophic level are the impala on?
questions.qAf: Op watter trofiese vlak is die rooibokke?
questions.explain: Impala are herbivores that eat producers, so they are primary consumers.
questions.explainAf: Rooibokke is herbivore wat produsente eet, dus is hulle primêre verbruikers.

questions.q: Once the wild dogs recover, the impala numbers are likely to fall again.
questions.qAf: Sodra die wildehonde herstel, sal die rooibokgetalle waarskynlik weer daal.
questions.explain: True. Predator and prey numbers rise and fall in a natural cycle that keeps both populations in balance.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Roofdier- en prooigetalle styg en daal in 'n natuurlike siklus wat albei bevolkings in balans hou.

questions.scenario: Liquid air is warmed slowly to separate its gases. Their boiling points are: nitrogen −196 °C, argon −186 °C and oxygen −183 °C.
questions.scenarioAf: Vloeibare lug word stadig verwarm om sy gasse te skei. Hul kookpunte is: stikstof −196 °C, argon −186 °C en suurstof −183 °C.

questions.q: Which gas boils off first as the liquid air warms up?
questions.qAf: Watter gas kook eerste af soos die vloeibare lug opwarm?
questions.explain: Nitrogen has the lowest boiling point (−196 °C), so it reaches its boiling point first.
questions.explainAf: Stikstof het die laagste kookpunt (−196 °C), dus bereik dit eerste sy kookpunt.

questions.q: What is the difference between the boiling points of nitrogen and oxygen?
questions.qAf: Wat is die verskil tussen die kookpunte van stikstof en suurstof?

questions.q: What is this separation process called?
questions.qAf: Wat word hierdie skeidingsproses genoem?
questions.explain: Fractional distillation separates substances with different boiling points, even in a homogeneous mixture like air.
questions.explainAf: Fraksionele distillasie skei stowwe met verskillende kookpunte, selfs in 'n homogene mengsel soos lug.

questions.q: Air is a mixture, not a compound.
questions.qAf: Lug is 'n mengsel, nie 'n verbinding nie.
questions.explain: True. Its gases are physically mixed, not chemically bonded, and its make-up can vary.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Sy gasse is fisies gemeng, nie chemies gebind nie, en sy samestelling kan wissel.

questions.scenario: A ship uses SONAR to measure the depth of the sea. It sends a pulse of ultrasound down and the echo comes back 0.6 s later. Sound travels through seawater at 1 500 m/s.
questions.scenarioAf: 'n Skip gebruik SONAR om die diepte van die see te meet. Dit stuur 'n puls ultraklank af en die weerklank kom 0,6 s later terug. Klank beweeg teen 1 500 m/s deur seewater.

questions.q: How far does the sound travel in total, down and back?
questions.qAf: Hoe ver beweeg die klank altesaam, af en terug?
questions.explain: Distance = speed × time = 1 500 × 0.6 = 900 m.
questions.explainAf: Afstand = spoed × tyd = 1 500 × 0,6 = 900 m.

questions.q: How deep is the sea at that point?
questions.qAf: Hoe diep is die see op daardie punt?
questions.explain: The sound went down and came back, so the depth is half of 900 m: 450 m.
questions.explainAf: Die klank het af gegaan en teruggekom, dus is die diepte die helfte van 900 m: 450 m.

questions.q: Humans cannot hear the ultrasound pulse.
questions.qAf: Mense kan nie die ultraklankpuls hoor nie.
questions.explain: True. Ultrasound is above 20 000 Hz, too high for the human ear.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Ultraklank is bo 20 000 Hz, te hoog vir die menslike oor.
